corpora.E2: Natural epoch 2 from the frozen CWPT corpus; prior complete-API screen showed severe CWPT-V2 regression.
corpora.E4: Natural epoch 4 from the frozen CWPT corpus; prior complete-API screen showed a CWPT-V2 gain.

scope: Audit-only causal contrast; results are excluded from the paper performance table.

predictions.claim: On E2, CWPT-V2 will exceed Baseline in at least one directly traced transition burden: fallback entries, XOF regeneration, state restore or recomputation, service-wave count, phase-launch count, or retirement stalls.
predictions.pass_condition: At least one listed aggregate is strictly larger for CWPT-V2 than Baseline on matched E2 inputs.

predictions.claim: The incremental transition burden of CWPT-V2 relative to Baseline will be lower on E4 than on E2.
predictions.pass_condition: A preregistered transition-burden score, computed from measured phase time without cell-specific weights, has delta(CWPT-V2-Baseline)_E4 < delta(CWPT-V2-Baseline)_E2.
predictions.falsifier: The E4 burden delta is equal to or greater than the E2 burden delta.

predictions.claim: The E2 complete-API regression direction is explained when newly incurred transition and wave costs exceed the measured speculative work saved by the lower service credit.
predictions.pass_condition: M2 attributes a positive net time delta to transition/wave/retirement terms and predicts the observed E2 regression direction without per-cell fitting.
predictions.falsifier: M2 predicts an E2 gain, or requires an E2-specific fitted coefficient.

predictions.claim: Population-only M0 and smooth N-times-C M1 cannot separate the observed E2 and E4 movement directions, whereas transition-aware wave model M2 can.
predictions.pass_condition: M2 classifies both E2 and E4 directions correctly and has lower holdout absolute error than M0 and M1; M0 or M1 misclassifies at least one corpus.
predictions.falsifier: M2 misses either direction, or M0/M1 separates both directions with equal or lower holdout error.

model_constraints.M1: One measured cost per phase; no resource penalty is multiplied onto measured time.
model_constraints.M2: At most one launch cost, wave cost, and wave capacity per phase; one cost per observed transition class; one retirement coefficient.
forbidden: changing fanout or credit after observing the audit
changing candidate sequence or kernel topology
using audit builds for headline performance

correctness_contract: audit trace contains no secret polynomial values
claim_boundary: Failure of any prediction limits the transition-causality claim; it does not falsify cost-weighted population theory in general.
